summary.zh: 面向AI算力池内加速器与交换机的低延迟、高带宽互连：200G每通道，单个计算池最多1,024个加速器；提供读、写与原子事务的加载/存储协议。
summary.en: Low-latency, high-bandwidth interconnect between accelerators and switches in an AI pod: 200G per lane, up to 1,024 accelerators per pod, with a load/store protocol using read, write and atomic transactions.

facts.zh: 联盟新闻稿称代表85家以上成员公司。
facts.en: The press release says the consortium represents more than 85 member companies.

facts.zh: 新闻稿称其设计目标为93%有效峰值带宽（联盟自述，未经独立验证）。
facts.en: The release cites 93% effective peak bandwidth as a design aim (consortium claim, not independently verified).

caveat.zh: 据单一来源，2026年4月出现2.0版；本页未核实。
caveat.en: One secondary source mentions a 2.0 version in April 2026; not verified here.

summary.zh: 开放的一致性互连：新增用于内存分层的热页监测单元（CHMU）、通用事件记录、在线固件激活，并通过可信安全协议（TSP）扩展安全；与此前所有CXL规范完全向后兼容。
summary.en: Open coherent interconnect: adds a Hot-Page Monitoring Unit (CHMU) for memory tiering, common event records, online firmware activation and extends security through the Trusted Security Protocol (TSP); fully backward compatible with all earlier CXL specifications.

caveat.zh: 仅一份百科类来源称CXL 4.0已于2025年11月18日发布（128 GT/s）；本页未核实。
caveat.en: Only an encyclopaedic source says CXL 4.0 was released on 18 Nov 2025 (128 GT/s); not verified here.
